description:
Step of fz-t93: a cycle group concludes together, for readers OUTSIDE it. Proposal page ../fz-afu.15.html (artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/4iwyuoz15h9ACqNe6QNb3x). Evidence: scratchpad afu15a/ (first probe), afu15x/ (E1 edits, E4 quiescence, E8 blow-up + A-out, E9 correctness), afu15y/ (E2 membership, E3/E7 early wakes, E5/E6/E10 job order). A-out patch: afu15x/probe_full_aout.diff.

Design (A-out, proven by experiment): the engine owns groups. A group forms at partner detection: reader, producer, every job on the wait path producer ->* reader (engine wait graph, fz-t93.2), with an existing group treated as ONE node anywhere along the path. Between two members of one group answer_use is unchanged (partner iff waits_reach, else local settledness, else Wait). A reader OUTSIDE the publisher's group sees the fact concluded only when locally settled AND the group is closed. A group is open from formation and re-opened when a member is enqueued; it closes at a member's completion when no member is queued or waiting, and reports its facts concluded in one more dispatch. The early local-settle wake to outside readers is kept (it is how a reader that parked before a cycle closed discovers it; holding it stalled 41 fixtures). Quiescent settlement treats a publisher in an open group as dirty (today safe only by argument). ForwardingWalk: an existing answer is a leaf; only a partner with no answer is walked.

Rejected by experiment: in-group reads as Partner (first probe) - jx_v2 849 AA vs 181, a 17-rung activation ladder; holding concluded flips until close (F1/F2/F7) - stalls; dissolve-on-close - deadlock via the path hole (fixed by group-as-node).

Results (A-out vs base): json_roundtrip same/2 = 8 under all 12 agenda orders (base 8-37), decode ReturnType read once at final revision (base 1-5 revisions); zero outside reads at a non-final revision on five programs, fifo and lifo; jx_v2 AA 164/143 vs 181/151 (fifo/lifo); real json AA 815/592 vs 882/597; no return type only in A-out; fixture matrix 3358/0/3 under fifo and lifo; distiller byte-identical; 10 source edits equal fresh compile; groups single job kind, each one SCC. Pins: only 00181 wakes 130->133 (three coalesced group-release wakes; runs identical) - needs approval; all else at pin.

Removal ledger: removes keying on unfinished rungs (order-dependent same/2), ForwardingWalk's Partner body walk; waits_reach also forms groups. Stays: derive_up_before_down (the group's own climb), callees_in_answer_order cycle handling; pending_strong_component goes at fz-t93.4/.7.

Build order: (1) failing trace tests: m8 and jx_v2 fixtures (same/2 = 1, decode read once, no ladder), three.fz outside reader reads once; (2) engine groups + wait-path query + is_concluded for outsiders + quiescence guard, unit tests in scheduler_test.rs; (3) ForwardingWalk leaf rule.

Close when: json same/2 = 8 with decode's return read once; fz-xxd.10 json ladder pin has no climbing rows; outputs identical; only approved pin moves.

History: original bug - roundtrip/1 read Json.decode's ReturnType at revisions 1 and 2 and keyed 16 same/2 activations (paper 8): fact_is_concluded holds between climb steps because a climb advances by revision wakes. Refuted cures S1-S5 (predicates over queued work/waits).
title: A caller reads a recursive callee's return only once its climb has finished
